Jules (Partnerships): Quick sync: we're planning a v2 removal that rewrites /partner/v1 -> /partner/v2 and changes the response envelope. We need a rollback/runbook in case partners hit issues.
Rafi (Eng): Noted. Can we define clear metrics that trigger rollback?
Ava (Platform): Proposed triggers: >1.5% error rate increase on proxied traffic for 2 consecutive 5m windows OR partner-specific failure rate >3% for 10m. If triggered, shim should auto-disable and mark partner as impacted.
Carmen (Marketplace): Also need a way to revert marketplace-installed connectors to pinned v1 if upgrade fails. One-click revert in console please.
Rafi (Eng): Technical approach: shim has feature-flag per-tenant; disable flag -> traffic flows to original endpoints. We'll emit X-SDK-Rollback header when rollback occurs.
Jules (Partnerships): Communication checklist on rollback: 1) automated email to affected partners 2) banner in partner console 3) create support ticket with pre-filled diagnostics 4) schedule 30m bridge.
Ava (Platform): Runbook steps (short):
1) Detect trigger in monitoring
2) Auto-disable shim for affected partner
3) Run smoke test against v1 endpoints
4) Notify partners + open bridge
5) Initiate one-click revert in marketplace if install changed
6) Roll-forward plan after fix

Example smoke test curl:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/partner/v1/check -d '{"ping":"ok"}' | jq .
```
Rafi (Eng): I'll add telemetry metrics: proxied_v1_err_pct, partner_error_rate, shim_disabled_events. ETA: PR by tomorrow EOD.
Carmen (Marketplace): I'll wire the console revert button to call the marketplace API and attach the smoke test result to the support ticket.
deprecate-bot: Scheduled: Partner SDK v1 removal notice to partners@redwood.ai on 2026-07-01T12:00:00Z
Jules (Partnerships): Great. Action items: Rafi - telemetry + header; Ava - implement per-tenant flag + auto-disable; Carmen - one-click revert; Me - partner comms + rollback templates. We'll run a dry-run canary next week. Ping me for urgent partner exceptions. :pray:
